established_contexts: Frozen C158190 one-way-to-two-way intersection, travel maneuver and stop_sign cell control; the selected yield-sign branch is a documented scope tension, not an observed Native fact.

variable_parameters.name: sign_type
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stop or yield sign with original Native sign and face readback

variable_parameters.name: stopping_reference
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: stop line, near-side crosswalk or nearest-view location with original evidence

variable_parameters.name: through_vehicle_state
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: approaching, already entered or absent through-highway actor staging

variable_parameters.name: commanded_approach_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s target; not a legal slowing cutoff

variable_parameters.name: commanded_view_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: positive engineering m/s target at the constructed view bracket

variable_parameters.name: through_highway_sight_clear
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original sampled sight-ray history; human visibility unresolved

variable_parameters.name: ego_in_intersection
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original ego-body overlap with sourced junction
